response.sql: SELECT r."name" AS "name", AVG(cs."wins") AS "avg_wins" FROM "constructorStandings" cs JOIN "races" r ON r."raceId" = cs."raceId" WHERE cs."points" > 6.0 GROUP BY r."name";

assumptions.assumption: The filter uses the season-to-date points value as the request states, and rows with NULL points are excluded because NULL > 6.0 is not true. The average uses the season-to-date wins value, and AVG skips NULL wins, returning NULL for a race name with no non-missing wins among its kept entries.
